cv.name: Elena Hrovat
cv.headline: Senior Compliance Officer | AML, anti-bribery and sanctions | Pharma and payments
cv.summary: Lawyer by training with twelve years in compliance across banking, payments and the pharmaceutical industry in Austria. I build and run compliance programmes, handle investigations and work in English across international groups.

Deliver anti-bribery and sanctions training for sales and procurement

experience.title: Compliance Officer AML
bullets: Money laundering reporting officer deputy; filing of suspicious activity reports with the FIU
Updated the AML risk assessment in line with the FM-GwG and FMA guidance

experience.title: Compliance Analyst
